# Desert Siren Katarina
A simple upgrade to sandstorm Katarina.
## Features:
- Desert themed particle effects
- New effects for Bouncing Blade and Death Lotus
- Up-scaled skin and splash art
- Matching HUD icons

## Also includes "Classic" version:
- Some classic animations
- Classic ability icons
- Classic Katarina art for minimap and tab screen
